summary.en: Kogoro is targeted by a killer who is after Kimura. Kogoro accidentally took his jacket at a bar and now the killer is trying to kill him. Location: Next to construction site Victim: Kogoro Mouri Cause: Debris collision Suspects: Mysterious killer Location: Cleaning Ogawa Shop Victim: Kogoro Mouri and Ogawa, as well as Ran Mouri, and Conan Edogawa Cause: Truck ramming Suspects: Mysterious killer When Kogoro noticed the truck, he threw himself on Ran and Conan moving them out of the way in time.
